name: rasuvaeff/payments-testing
description: Deterministic fake payment gateways and framework-agnostic contract assertions for testing

scripts.bc-check:
sh -c 'git config --global --add safe.directory /app 2>/dev/null || true; LATEST=; for ARG in "$@"; do case "$ARG" in --from=*) LATEST="${ARG#--from=}";; esac; done; if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then LATEST=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then echo "No previous tag - skipping BC check"; exit 0; fi; set -- --from="$LATEST"; fi; CODE=0; OUTPUT=$(roave-backward-compatibility-check "$@" 2>&1) || CODE=$?; printf "%s
" "$OUTPUT"; if [ "$CODE" -eq 3 ]; then TOTAL=$(printf "%s
" "$OUTPUT" | { grep -cE "^\[BC\] " || true; }); SKIPPED=$(printf "%s
" "$OUTPUT" | { grep -cE "^\[BC\] SKIPPED:" || true; }); if [ "$TOTAL" -gt 0 ] && [ "$TOTAL" -eq "$SKIPPED" ]; then echo "All $TOTAL finding(s) are roave/better-reflection SKIPPED entries (a static-analysis limitation, not a detected break); treating as pass."; exit 0; fi; NEXT=$(grep -m1 -oE "^## [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" CHANGELOG.md | grep -oE "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" | head -1); LATEST_VERSION="${LATEST#v}"; LATEST_MAJOR="${LATEST_VERSION%%.*}"; LATEST_MINOR="${LATEST_VERSION#*.}"; LATEST_MINOR="${LATEST_MINOR%%.*}"; NEXT_MAJOR="${NEXT%%.*}"; NEXT_MINOR="${NEXT#*.}"; NEXT_MINOR="${NEXT_MINOR%%.*}"; case "$LATEST_MAJOR.$LATEST_MINOR" in *[!0-9.]*|.*|*.) NEXT=;; esac; if [ -n "$NEXT" ] && { [ "$NEXT_MAJOR" -gt "$LATEST_MAJOR" ] || { [ "$LATEST_MAJOR" -eq 0 ] && [ "$NEXT_MAJOR" -eq 0 ] && [ "$NEXT_MINOR" -gt "$LATEST_MINOR" ]; }; }; then echo "CHANGELOG declares $NEXT - an intentional compatibility boundary over $LATEST; BC breaks are expected, treating as pass."; exit 0; fi; fi; exit "$CODE"' --
